summary: Iteration 2 retest at 390x844 plus backend pytest (29/29 pass). All iteration_1 fixes are verified. (1) Agent Controls: a Gemini limit of 20000 shows the toast 'Limit must be between $0 and $10,000', the input resets to 150, and there is no redbox or '[object Object]'. A valid limit (175) still saves with a toast. (2) Tapping Back during the Face ID scan stays on PAYMENT and no longer jumps to Authorize. (3) Back/close on /agents, /activity and /journey opened directly by URL goes to '/'. Backend: tokenize returns 400 before authorize and after decline. Authorize on a canceled/completed session returns the existing txn unchanged. Complete is idempotent (same order_id; payment_option and points unchanged). quantity 0/-1/21 and tip -1 return 422. Unknown agent_id returns 404. Limit 20000 returns 422. The frontend calls authorize before tokenize, and on decline it makes no tokenize call. Stepper on decline: steps 1-4 green, PAY shows '5' (not done), and the last step is labelled DECLINED with a red X. Happy-path regression passes: suggestion -> LLM widget -> checkout -> continue -> Face ID -> approve -> Flex Pay -> Confirmed (+276 pts, 6 x $9.21/mo, IC- order) -> Activity. The checkout session is reused after back/forward (only 1 POST). No deprecated Expo packages.

minor.issue: A session in status 'authorized' (approved, token already issued, not yet paid) can be re-authorized. With decision=decline the txn flips to declined and the session to canceled, but agent_token stays on the session. With approve it regenerates the auth_code. Suggest returning the existing txn unless status is ready_for_payment.

issues: The screenshot taken right after the step mounted shows the card, Approve and Decline at low opacity (fade-in animation mid-way). This is probably just entrance timing, but check that the buttons are not tappable while dimmed.

action_items: Optional: guard /citi/authorize so it returns the existing txn when session.status == 'authorized' (not only completed/canceled).
critical_code_review_comments: journey.decide(): if tokenize fails after an approve, the user stays on Authorize with an error. Retrying calls authorize again, which re-authorizes (see the backend minor issue).

Transient 502s from the Metro dev server (/hot, /symbolicate, Ionicons.ttf) during direct-URL loads once showed the toast 'Failed to load font Ionicons' and icons rendered as boxes. This is an environment issue, not app code.
Good: FaceIdStep timers are stored in a ref and cleared on unmount. api.ts flattens array 422 details. Back buttons use canGoBack() ? back() : replace('/').
